marks.gloss_en: אמר ליה: וכי לייבשן הוא צריך? -- on the roof the lulavim would only be set out to dry, which is not the purpose; unanswered, the reading is replaced by על גב
Rav Nachman: and does he need to dry them?!
שמע מינה -- from the baraita's 'so that they lean over the altar one amah' it follows that they stood on the yesod
Mar Zutra: conclude from it that they are placed on the yesod [of the altar]
מאי קראה: אסרו חג בעבותים עד קרנות המזבח (no support kind for מאי קראה; svara stands in, as sukkah_33b_arvei_nachal)
R' Abbahu: what is the verse? 'isru chag ba'avotim until the horns of the altar' (Tehillim 118:27)
the mishna: they come and stand [the willows] upright at the sides of the altar, with their tops bent over the altar
the baraita: [the willows were] many, long, and eleven amot high
as its performance on a weekday, so is its performance on Shabbat
it was taught: [Motza] was a place of kelanya
